annotations.title: Observed crawler path on a site

description: Returns, for each crawler identity (ClaudeBot, GPTBot, Googlebot and others), where its path into a domain stops: edge, robots file, then the page, JSON-LD, sitemap, llms file and entity map. Give agent for one crawler and a one-line answer. Uses the record on file or scans first. Use for which AI crawlers can reach a site. For robots.txt rules alone use resolve_robots.

agent.description: Identity id or label, e.g. claudebot, GPTBot, Googlebot

fresh.description: Scan now instead of using the record on file
